import json, math
conf=json.load(open('/root/config.json'))
report=json.load(open('/root/report.json'))
reqs=[json.loads(l) for l in open('/root/trace.jsonl') if l.strip()]
assert report['total_requests'] == len(reqs) == 2000
assert len(report['per_request']) == len(reqs)
assert report['total_prompt_tokens'] == sum(r['input_length'] for r in reqs)
assert report['total_hit_tokens'] == sum(x['hit_tokens'] for x in report['per_request'])
assert abs(report['overall_hit_rate'] - report['total_hit_tokens']/report['total_prompt_tokens']) < 1e-15
assert 0 <= report['final_cache_blocks'] <= conf['cache_capacity_blocks']
bs=conf['block_size']
for i, (entry, req) in enumerate(zip(report['per_request'], reqs)):
    assert entry['idx'] == i
    assert entry['prompt_tokens'] == req['input_length']
    assert len(req['hash_ids']) == math.ceil(req['input_length']/bs)
    assert 0 <= entry['hit_tokens'] <= entry['prompt_tokens']
    assert entry['hit_tokens'] == entry['prompt_tokens'] or entry['hit_tokens'] % bs == 0
print('validated report.json')
